description: A reverb, the Rack port of Freeverb, whose outputs carry the reverberated signal alone at full stereo separation

params.text: Sets the length of the reverb tail, 0 to 1
Sets how fast the high frequencies fall away in the reverb tail, 0 to 1
Holds the reverb tail indefinitely and blocks new sound from entering it; a second press releases it

inputs.text: The signal fed into the reverb, clamped to -10V and 10V
Sets the reverb tail from its voltage over the range 0-8V, and the Roomsize knob has no effect while a cable is patched here
Sets the damping from its voltage over the range 0-8V, and the Damping knob has no effect while a cable is patched here
Above 1V the reverb tail is held indefinitely and new sound is blocked from entering it, and the Freeze button has no effect while a cable is patched here

outputs.text: The reverberated signal on the left channel, with no part of the input mixed in
The reverberated signal on the right channel, with no part of the input mixed in

inputs.3: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
